name: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Whisk flour, sugar and salt in a large bowl
Combine milk and butter and heat til warm to the touch. Then whisk yeast until it is dissolved
Pour yeast mixture into the dry ingredients and add egg. Mix until a soft dough forms
Transfer dough onto lightly floured surface and knead for 3-5 minutes
Place dough into a lightly greased bowl and cover and rest for 10 minutes
For filling, put softened butter, cinnamon and brown sugar into a bowl and mix well
After 10 minutes, roll out the dough into a 14x8 in rectangle and spread the filling mixture on the dough
Roll dough into a 14 inch log and cut into a 10 pieces and place into a well greased round cake pan (9 in)
Cover pan and place in warm area for 60-90 minutes or until doubled in size
Preheat oven to 375° F and bake rolls for 24-27 minutes or until lightly browned.
For frosting, mix vanilla, sugar and softened cream cheese in a bowl
Once rolls are done, spread frosting mixture across all rolls
